findings.description: The new review-catch-only arms enter component decisions, but Analysis.primaries() assigns them both hidden_test_pass_rate and defect_catch_rate. They never run build tasks, so the hidden-test primary cannot have paired observations.
findings.failure_mode: Even with sufficient review observations demonstrating equivalent performance, decide() cannot return remove or simplify because it requires usable observations for every primary. These arms therefore receive systematically incomplete decisions.
findings.suggested_fix: Select primaries according to each arm's task applicability, using only defect_catch_rate for review-catch-only arms.
findings.demotion_reason: Demoted: anchor not in diff scope

findings.description: Excluding eval_only arms from components also excludes a1_full_openmount from detail_arms and report.json's arms. Its trial rows remain admissible, but the report exposes no results for the open-mount evaluation control.
findings.failure_mode: A completed batch containing the oracle A/B produces no reported open-mount results, preventing the comparison this arm was introduced to measure.
findings.suggested_fix: Maintain separate collections for decision components and reported arms. Include eval_only arms in detailed results and JSON output while excluding them from shipped-default decisions and the component comparison count.
findings.demotion_reason: Demoted: anchor not in diff scope

findings.description: The expected-false-positive sentence uses k = len(components) = 9 as the number of comparisons at the stated level, but the three new components (a0_bare_fable, a1_review_only, a1_no_dissent) are review-catch only and a2/a4/a5/a6 are build only. No component is tested on both primaries, so the true per-primary comparison count is 6 for hidden_test_pass_rate and 5 for defect_catch_rate. The pre-registered rules block the report quotes verbatim still reads 'over 6 components'. This was already imprecise before the change (k=6 mixed build-only and all arms) but the change widens the gap and the report now contradicts its own quoted rules text.
findings.failure_mode: The Method section reports 0.45 / 0.90 expected false positives when the actual exposure per primary is 0.30 / 0.25, and the mirrored rules comment in ablation-2.0.yaml:117 and NOTES disagrees with the generated sentence, so a reader cannot tell which number was pre-registered.
findings.suggested_fix: Compute k per primary (components whose task_types intersect that primary's task family) and emit one EFP sentence per primary, or restrict k to the pre-registered decision arms and update the suite rules comment/NOTES in the same change so the quoted block and the generated line agree.

findings.cross_file_justification: The refusal is added in pipeline-run.sh but the only call site that sets LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1 is run-ablation.sh run_trial. Any other caller of pipeline-run.sh over the full arm list is now affected.
findings.description: The eval_only refusal applies to --dry-run as well as real runs, and the only launcher that sets the batch marker is run_trial in run-ablation.sh (the variable is deliberately set on the trial command only). Any other code path that iterates every runnable arm through pipeline-run.sh (an image self-check, a preflight that dry-runs each arm to estimate cost or validate plans, operator tooling, CI smoke that calls pipeline-run.sh directly) will now exit 2 on a1_full_openmount with no pipeline.json written. The PR context says a suite-root image self-check is part of this sprint but it is not in the diff, so parity with that caller cannot be confirmed from the diff.
findings.failure_mode: A caller that treats every non-absent suite arm as runnable aborts or records a spurious failure for a1_full_openmount the first time it is invoked without the marker; because no pipeline.json is written, a runner that synthesises a record would classify it as interrupted and may retry.
findings.suggested_fix: Either exempt --dry-run from the refusal (it creates nothing, so the guard protects nothing there) or audit every pipeline-run.sh call site in the repo (including the self-check referenced in the PR title) and set LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1 there too; add a bats case that runs the full-arm iteration path against the committed suite.
